title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: a link with an unknown vendor ignores it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a vendor, vendor A, with overdue bills on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
custom_steps:
1. In the Vendor filter, tick vendor A.
  2. In the address bar, after vendor A's code (the text after "vendorIds="), add a comma and "Nobody".
  3. Press Enter.
  4. In the address bar, replace everything after "vendorIds=" with "Nobody".
  5. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The chip reads "Vendor: " and vendor A's name.
  • Only vendor A's group is listed.
  • The page address carries "vendorIds=" followed by vendor A's code (a long code, not the name).

Step 2:

  • The address bar shows vendor A's code, a comma and "Nobody" after "vendorIds=".

Step 3:

  • The report loads normally, with no error.
  • The chip reads "Vendor: " and vendor A's name.
  • Only vendor A's group is listed: the unknown vendor is ignored.

Step 4:

  • The address bar shows "Nobody" after "vendorIds=".

Step 5:

  • The report loads normally, with no error.
  • The chip reads "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style: with no known vendor left, the link opens as if none were ticked.

Why: a link saved earlier can name a vendor that was since deleted or merged; the tech plan says such a link must still open the report.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R19: “The ticked customers or vendors and the ticked Past due ranges are kept in the page address like Location (S5-R10).”
  • S5-R14: “A customer or vendor ticked through a link, a reload or a Summary drill-down is named and ticked on the chip, even when it is not among the first results of the chip's search.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D29: “Unknown or unresolvable customer/vendor/location ids in a link are dropped by the FE during the opening reconcile (resolve endpoint / option list) before any request, so the BE 422 is never reached from the UI”
  • Tech plan §3 D29, rationale: “Mirrors S5-N2 for customers/vendors (a deleted or merged customer in an old link must not break the report).”
  • Tech plan §3 D30: “URL keys asOfDate, customerIds / vendorIds, pastDue, locationIds (repeated keys written, comma lists also read); legacy customerId / vendorId read once as aliases.”
